title: DevSecOps pipeline (capstone)
subtitle: Faza 3 plana: sigurnosne kontrole u CI/CD-u. Tajne (gitleaks, Vault), SAST (Semgrep), SCA (osv-scanner, Trivy), IaC (Checkov), kontejneri, policy-as-code (OPA, Kyverno), SBOM, cosign i SLSA, DAST (ZAP) i quality gate, kroz GitLab pipeline nad pravim repoom, bez interneta.

exam.note: Za ovu fazu nema jednog zvaničnog ispita: rezultat je tvoj pipeline (modul „Capstone“). Ova simulacija je samoprovjera znanja; ako želiš sertifikat, isto gradivo pokrivaju Practical DevSecOps CDP (praktičan ispit) i, za tajne, HashiCorp Vault Associate.

domains.name: DevSecOps temelji i sigurnost CI/CD platforme
domains.name_en: DevSecOps foundations and CI/CD platform security

domains.name: IaC, kontejneri i policy-as-code
domains.name_en: IaC, containers and policy as code

exam.note_en: There is no single official exam for this phase: the result is your pipeline (the “Capstone” module). This simulation is a self-check; if you want a certification, the same material is covered by Practical DevSecOps CDP (a hands-on exam) and, for secrets, HashiCorp Vault Associate.

objectives.en: DevSecOps principles: shift-left, secure SDLC (NIST SSDF), maturity models (OWASP DSOMM, SAMM)
objectives.bs: Principi DevSecOps-a: shift-left, siguran SDLC (NIST SSDF), modeli zrelosti (OWASP DSOMM, SAMM)

objectives.en: Threat modeling for applications and pipelines; choosing controls per pipeline stage
objectives.bs: Modelovanje prijetnji za aplikaciju i pipeline; izbor kontrola po fazama pipelinea

objectives.en: CI/CD platform risks (OWASP Top 10 CI/CD), poisoned pipeline execution, runner isolation
objectives.bs: Rizici CI/CD platforme (OWASP Top 10 CI/CD), poisoned pipeline execution, izolacija runnera

objectives.en: Pipeline identity: OIDC/ID tokens to cloud and Vault, protected branches and variables, least privilege for jobs
objectives.bs: Identitet pipelinea: OIDC/ID tokeni prema oblaku i Vaultu, zaštićene grane i varijable, najmanje privilegije za jobove

objectives.en: Secret detection in code and git history (gitleaks, TruffleHog)
objectives.bs: Otkrivanje tajni u kodu i git istoriji (gitleaks, TruffleHog)

objectives.en: Preventing secret leaks: pre-commit hooks, push protection, baselines and allowlists
objectives.bs: Sprječavanje curenja: pre-commit hookovi, push protection, baseline i allowlist

objectives.en: Responding to a leaked secret: revoke, rotate, investigate, rewrite history
objectives.bs: Odgovor na procurjelu tajnu: opoziv, rotacija, istraga, prepisivanje istorije

objectives.en: Secrets management with HashiCorp Vault: KV, policies, auth methods (AppRole, JWT/OIDC), dynamic secrets
objectives.bs: Upravljanje tajnama u HashiCorp Vaultu: KV, politike, auth metode (AppRole, JWT/OIDC), dinamičke tajne

objectives.en: SAST: Semgrep rules, taint mode, tuning false positives, SARIF output
objectives.bs: SAST: Semgrep pravila, taint analiza, smanjenje lažnih pozitiva, SARIF izlaz

objectives.en: SCA: finding vulnerable dependencies from lockfiles (osv-scanner, Trivy), prioritizing with CVSS, EPSS and KEV
objectives.bs: SCA: ranjive zavisnosti iz lockfajlova (osv-scanner, Trivy), prioritizacija po CVSS, EPSS i KEV

objectives.en: Dependency hygiene: pinning, automated updates (Renovate, Dependabot), dependency confusion, typosquatting and malicious packages
objectives.bs: Higijena zavisnosti: pinovanje, automatska ažuriranja (Renovate, Dependabot), dependency confusion, typosquatting i zlonamjerni paketi

objectives.en: Open source license compliance
objectives.bs: Usklađenost sa licencama otvorenog koda

objectives.en: IaC scanning (Checkov, Trivy misconfig), custom checks and justified suppressions
objectives.bs: Skeniranje IaC-a (Checkov, Trivy misconfig), vlastite provjere i obrazložena izuzeća

objectives.en: Secure container builds: Dockerfile linting (hadolint), minimal and distroless images, non-root, multi-stage
objectives.bs: Siguran build kontejnera: lint Dockerfilea (hadolint), minimalne i distroless slike, non-root, multi-stage

objectives.en: Image scanning and gating: severity thresholds, unfixed vulnerabilities, .trivyignore and VEX
objectives.bs: Skeniranje slika i gate: pragovi ozbiljnosti, ranjivosti bez popravke, .trivyignore i VEX

objectives.en: Policy as code: OPA/Rego with Conftest, Kyverno policies and CLI
objectives.bs: Policy as code: OPA/Rego sa Conftestom, Kyverno politike i CLI

objectives.en: SBOM: CycloneDX and SPDX, generating with Syft/Trivy, scanning SBOMs, regulatory drivers (EU CRA, US EO 14028)
objectives.bs: SBOM: CycloneDX i SPDX, generisanje (Syft, Trivy), skeniranje SBOM-a, regulatorni razlozi (EU CRA, US EO 14028)

objectives.en: Signing artifacts with Sigstore cosign: key pairs, keyless (Fulcio, Rekor), verification
objectives.bs: Potpisivanje artefakata sa Sigstore cosignom: par ključeva, keyless (Fulcio, Rekor), provjera

objectives.en: Provenance and attestations: in-toto, SLSA levels and build track
objectives.bs: Provenance i atestacije: in-toto, SLSA nivoi i build track

objectives.en: Enforcing integrity at deploy time: verify signatures and attestations before deploy, admission policies
objectives.bs: Provođenje integriteta pri deployu: provjera potpisa i atestacija prije deploya, admission politike

objectives.en: DAST with OWASP ZAP: baseline, full and API scans, automation framework
objectives.bs: DAST sa OWASP ZAP-om: baseline, full i API skeniranje, automation framework

objectives.en: Aggregating results: SARIF, merge request reports, vulnerability management platforms (DefectDojo)
objectives.bs: Objedinjavanje rezultata: SARIF, izvještaji u merge requestu, platforme za upravljanje ranjivostima (DefectDojo)

objectives.en: Quality gates, triage, risk acceptance with expiry, SLAs and metrics (MTTR, escape rate)
objectives.bs: Quality gate, trijaža, prihvatanje rizika sa rokom, SLA i metrike (MTTR, escape rate)

sources.title: GitLab CI/CD: ID tokeni i OIDC
sources.title_en: GitLab CI/CD: ID tokens and OIDC

subtitle_en: Phase 3 of the plan: security controls in CI/CD. Secrets (gitleaks, Vault), SAST (Semgrep), SCA (osv-scanner, Trivy), IaC (Checkov), containers, policy as code (OPA, Kyverno), SBOM, cosign and SLSA, DAST (ZAP) and a quality gate, all in a GitLab pipeline over a real repo, offline.
